real_prompts.name: CRM with payments
real_prompts.prompt: Build a CRM with login, contacts management, a sales pipeline dashboard, role-based access for admin/manager/rep, and a premium plan with Stripe payments. Admins can see analytics.

real_prompts.name: E-commerce store
real_prompts.prompt: Create an e-commerce platform with product catalog, shopping cart, checkout with Stripe, order tracking, admin dashboard for inventory, and customer accounts with order history.

real_prompts.name: Project management tool
real_prompts.prompt: Build a project management app like Trello. Users can create boards, add lists and cards, assign tasks to team members, set due dates, and comment on cards. Admin can manage users.

real_prompts.name: SaaS analytics dashboard
real_prompts.prompt: Build a SaaS analytics platform where companies can connect their data sources, view charts and KPIs on a dashboard, invite team members, and have different subscription tiers.

real_prompts.name: Job board marketplace
real_prompts.prompt: Create a job board where employers can post jobs and manage applications, candidates can apply and track their applications, and admins moderate content. Include email notifications.

real_prompts.name: LMS (Learning Management System)
real_prompts.prompt: Build a learning management system where instructors create courses with videos and quizzes, students enroll and track progress, and admins manage the platform. Add certificate generation.

real_prompts.name: Healthcare appointment system
real_prompts.prompt: Build an appointment booking system for a clinic. Patients can book appointments with doctors, doctors manage their schedules, receptionists handle check-ins, and admins see reports.

real_prompts.name: Real estate platform
real_prompts.prompt: Create a real estate listing platform where agents list properties, buyers browse and save listings, schedule viewings, and submit offers. Admins verify agents.

real_prompts.name: Social media app
real_prompts.prompt: Build a social media app where users post content, follow each other, like and comment on posts, and have a feed. Include moderation tools for admins.

real_prompts.name: Restaurant ordering system
real_prompts.prompt: Build a restaurant management system with online ordering, menu management, order tracking for kitchen staff, table reservations, and sales reports for managers.

edge_cases.name: Conflicting roles
edge_cases.prompt: Build an app where all users are admins but admins cannot access the admin panel. Regular users have full admin access but admins do not.

edge_cases.name: Contradictory requirements
edge_cases.prompt: Build an app that is completely free but also charges users $100/month. Data should be stored but never saved. Users must login but there are no accounts.

edge_cases.name: Missing critical info
edge_cases.prompt: Build a platform for our business. Add the usual features.

edge_cases.name: Too many features
edge_cases.prompt: Build an app with login, social feed, e-commerce, CRM, project management, analytics, AI chatbot, video streaming, file storage, payment processing, email marketing, calendar, maps integration, blockchain, AR features, real-time collaboration, and offline mode.

edge_cases.name: Jargon heavy
edge_cases.prompt: Build a B2B SaaS multi-tenant white-label platform with SSO, RBAC, SCIM provisioning, SOC2 compliance hooks, audit logs, and a GraphQL API with federation.
